title: Electric Borders, Liquid Docks, Kinetic Weight & a 3D Loop
description: Five 2026 drops: an SVG-noise electric card border, a liquid glass dock with a curtain menu, weight-morphing headlines, a spring-wobble CTA, and a 3D perspective carousel.

drops.title: Electric Border
drops.description: A live current crackles around each card's edge using pure SVG distortion filters.
drops.concept: Instead of a static glowing outline, the border itself looks like it's crackling with electricity — a fast-spreading 'hero card' treatment for SaaS and AI landing pages in 2026. It reads as premium because the noise is genuinely animated, not a looping sprite.

interaction.mouse: Hover has no effect by design — the current runs continuously
interaction.click: Use the debug panel to tune distortion scale, current speed and accent color
interaction.touch: Cards render and animate identically on touch devices

drops.title: Liquid Pill Dock
drops.description: A floating glass dock that blooms into a full-screen radial curtain menu.
drops.concept: Pairs two patterns that are everywhere on portfolio and agency sites right now: an iOS/macOS-style floating bottom dock with tactile hover lift, and a 'radial curtain' menu that unfurls from the exact point you clicked using an animated clip-path: circle().

interaction.mouse: Hover a dock icon to see it lift; click the ☰ icon to bloom the curtain menu open from that point
interaction.click: Click any curtain nav link, the ✕, or press Escape to close
interaction.touch: Tap targets are 46px and behave the same as mouse

drops.title: Kinetic Weight Headlines
drops.description: Headlines animate from featherweight to full-bold as they scroll into view.
drops.concept: One of the clearest 2026 typography trends now that font-variation-settings has full browser support: headlines gain real visual mass as they arrive, staggered word by word, instead of the older approach of swapping between static font files.
drops.source: index studio — "Decathlon Yestalgia" (Awwwards Site of the Day, Aug 28 2026)

interaction.mouse: Scroll to trigger each headline as it crosses into view
interaction.click: Tune stagger delay and peak weight in the debug panel
interaction.touch: Scrolling on touch triggers the same IntersectionObserver reveal

drops.title: Jiggly Hover CTA
drops.description: A call-to-action that wobbles like a spring flicked from its base, not a magnetic drift.
drops.concept: A playful departure from the now-ubiquitous flat magnetic-button hover: an oscillating overshoot-and-decay rotation pivoting from the button's bottom edge, paired with chips that reveal a label via a clip-path wipe.
drops.source: FUTURE THREE — "Aardvark Book Club" (Awwwards Site of the Day, Aug 30 2026)

interaction.mouse: Hover any CTA to trigger the wobble; hover a chip to reveal its count
interaction.click: Adjust wobble intensity and duration in the debug panel
interaction.touch: Tap-and-hold triggers the same :hover/:focus-visible animation on most touch browsers

drops.title: Perspective Loop Slider
drops.description: Cards fan through real 3D space and rotate to face you as they pass, forever.
drops.concept: Reworks the tired flat carousel into a true perspective-space slider — CSS 3D pushed harder for depth without WebGL, currently surging in landing-page hero sections. Position is driven by drag or wheel input but never snaps instantly, using lerp damping for a heavy, physical glide with infinite wraparound.

interaction.mouse: Drag to spin the carousel, scroll wheel also works, hover a card for its caption
interaction.click: Tune perspective depth, damping and max rotation in the debug panel
interaction.touch: Drag with a finger; the pointer-events handlers work identically on touch
